record.bible_text: And the men<WH0376> of Ephraim<WH0669> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Why hast thou<WH04100> served<WH06213><WTH8804> us thus<WH01697>, that thou calledst<WH07121><WTH8800> us not, when thou wentest<WH01980><WTH8804> to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> with the Midianites<WH04080>? And he went up<WH05927><WTH8799> thence to Penuel<WH06439>, and spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto them likewise<WH02063>: and the men<WH0582> of Penuel<WH06439> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> him as the men<WH0582> of Succoth<WH05523> had answered<WH06030><WTH8804> <FI>him<Fi> .

Now Zebah<WH02078> and Zalmunna<WH06759> <FI>were<Fi> in Karkor<WH07174>, and their hosts<WH04264> with them, about fifteen<WH02568><WH06240> thousand<WH0505> <FI>men<Fi> , all that were left<WH03498><WTH8737> of all the hosts<WH04264> of the children<WH01121> of the east<WH06924>: for there fell<WH05307><WTH8802> an hundred<WH03967> and twenty<WH06242> thousand<WH0505> men<WH0376> that drew<WH08025><WTH8802> sword<WH02719>. <RF>men that...: or, every one drawing a sword<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, They <FI>were<Fi> my brethren<WH0251>, <FI>even<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of my mother<WH0517>: <FI>as<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, if<WH03863> ye had saved them alive<WH02421><WTH8689>, I would not slay<WH02026><WTH8804> you.

Then Zebah<WH02078> and Zalmunna<WH06759> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Rise<WH06965><WTH8798> thou, and fall<WH06293><WTH8798> upon us: for as the man<WH0376> <FI>is, so is<Fi> his strength<WH01369>. Then the men<WH0376> of Israel<WH03478> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Gideon<WH01439>, Rule<WH04910><WTH8798> thou over us, both thou, and thy son<WH01121>, and thy son's<WH01121> son<WH01121> also: for thou hast delivered<WH03467><WTH8689> us from the hand<WH03027> of Midian<WH04080>.

And Gideon<WH01439> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, I will not rule<WH04910><WTH8799> over you, neither shall my son<WH01121> rule<WH04910><WTH8799> over you: the LORD<WH03068> shall rule<WH04910><WTH8799> over you.

And Gideon<WH01439> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, I would desire<WH07592><WTH8799> a request<WH07596> of you, that ye would give<WH05414><WTH8798> me every man<WH0376> the earrings<WH05141> of his prey<WH07998>. (For they had golden<WH02091> earrings<WH05141>, because they <FI>were<Fi> Ishmaelites<WH03459>.)

And they answered<WH0559><WTH8799>, We will willingly<WH05414><WTH8800> give<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> . And they spread<WH06566><WTH8799> a garment<WH08071>, and did cast<WH07993><WTH8686> therein every man<WH0376> the earrings<WH05141> of his prey<WH07998>.

And the weight<WH04948> of the golden<WH02091> earrings<WH05141> that he requested<WH07592><WTH8804> was a thousand<WH0505> and seven<WH07651> hundred<WH03967> <FI>shekels<Fi> of gold<WH02091>; beside ornaments<WH07720>, and collars<WH05188>, and purple<WH0713> raiment<WH0899> that <FI>was<Fi> on the kings<WH04428> of Midian<WH04080>, and beside the chains<WH06060> that <FI>were<Fi> about their camels<WH01581>' necks<WH06677>. <RF>collars: or, sweet jewels<Rf>
